newsitem.title: CHINA: Northern Tel venture in $25 mln China deal.
newsitem.headline: Northern Tel venture in $25 mln China deal.

text.p: A joint venture between Northern Telecom Ltd of Canada and China has signed an accord to sell $25 million of telephone switching equipment to telecommunications authorities in Beijing, the China Daily said on Monday.
China's Guangdong Nortel Telecommunications Switching Equipment Ltd would supply DMS-100 switching equipment to the Beijing Telecommunications Administration.
Guangdong Nortel, based in the southern province of Guangdong, was launched in March 1995 to produce the DMS SuperNode family of switching products for private and public telecommunications.
Chinese partners in the venture include the Guangdong Macro Group and companies under the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications.

The purchase of the equipment, which would be supported by Canadian government export loans, would allow the Beijing Telecommunications Adminstration to upgrade its services, the newspaper said without giving further details.
The joint venture had already signed similar deals with a number of other Chinese cities and provinces, it said.
